exercises.question: Which sentence has a relative clause with a preposition?
options: El fallo afecta a un servicio del que dependen muchas personas. [The fault affects a service on which many people depend.]
Hay un atasco que impide que los autobuses lleguen a tiempo. [There is a traffic jam that prevents buses from arriving on time.]
Los autobuses llegan a tiempo a todas las paradas. [Buses arrive on time at all the stops.]

exercises.sentence: La situación se agravó __ nadie actuó a tiempo.
exercises.english: The situation got worse because nobody acted in time.
It is necessary that we address the cause of the problem.

sentences: El sistema dejó de funcionar de repente. [The system suddenly stopped working.]
Nadie sabía la causa exacta. [Nobody knew the exact cause.]
Finalmente, un técnico encontró el problema. [Finally, a technician found the problem.]

exercises.question: Which expression introduces an imagined condition?
options: si tuviéramos [if we had]
como consecuencia [as a consequence]
sin embargo [however]

exercises.sentence: Si la primera solución no __, buscaría una alternativa.
exercises.english: If the first solution did not work, I would look for an alternative.
A quick change would avoid more problems.

exercises.question: Which sentence recommends an action, with the subjunctive?
options: Es importante que actuemos a tiempo. [It is important that we act in time.]
Actuamos a tiempo todos los días. [We act in time every day.]
Actuaremos a tiempo en el futuro. [We will act in time in the future.]

exercises.sentence: La falta de mantenimiento desencadenó varios fallos.
options: The lack of maintenance triggered several failures.
The lack of maintenance solved several failures.
The lack of maintenance had no effect.

exercises.sentence: Mi jefe resolvería el fallo pronto.
options: My boss would resolve the fault soon.
My boss resolved the fault yesterday.
My boss will resolve it tomorrow.

exercises.sentence: Es importante que resolvamos esto cuanto antes.
exercises.english: It is important that we resolve this as soon as possible.

options: La falta de mantenimiento los desencadenó. [The lack of maintenance triggered them.]
La falta de mantenimiento fue una alternativa. [The lack of maintenance was an alternative.]
La falta de mantenimiento fue una consecuencia. [The lack of maintenance was a consequence.]
Es necesario que abordemos la causa del problema. [It is necessary that we address the cause of the problem.]
Es necesario que abordamos la causa del problema. [It is necessary that we address the cause of the problem.]
Es necesario que abordaríamos la causa del problema. [It is necessary that we would address the cause of the problem.]

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: ¿Qué harías si la solución no funcionara?

options: Buscaría una alternativa. [I would look for an alternative.]
Busque una alternativa. [I look (subjunctive) for an alternative.]
Busqué una alternativa. [I looked for an alternative.]

exercises.question: Which sentence gives a problem, a cause and a response?
options: El problema se agravó porque no se actuó a tiempo; por eso es necesario que abordemos su causa. [The problem got worse because action was not taken in time; so it is necessary that we address its cause.]
El problema del tráfico se agravó mucho porque no se tomaron medidas a tiempo en la ciudad. [The traffic problem got worse a lot because measures were not taken in time in the city.]
Es necesario que abordemos la causa del problema y que busquemos otra solución pronto. [It is necessary that we address the cause of the problem and look for another solution soon.]

template.prompt: Say that the problem got worse because action was not taken in time, and that for this reason it is necessary to address its cause.
template.answer: El problema se agravó porque no se actuó a tiempo, por eso es necesario que abordemos su causa.

template.prompt: Say that the first alternative seems useful but would be difficult to implement, and that, in short, you must choose a viable solution.
template.answer: La primera alternativa parece útil; sin embargo, sería difícil aplicarla. En resumen, debemos elegir una solución viable.
